messages:
Claire (RevRec): Noticing a disconnect on the May close  several "onboarding grant" credits were booked as immediate discounts. Need reclass guidance and whether this is a prior period correction.
Derek (Billing): Which SKUs/invoices?
Claire (RevRec): SKUs: ONBOARD-GRANT, ONBOARD-GRANT-PLUS. Affected invoices: INV-14021 (HelioTech) $32,500, INV-14035 (CrestAI) $14,750, INV-14040 (OrbitWorks) $5,600. Terms were 12-month onboarding grants.
Hannah (Accounting): Sounds like GL 4300 (Sales Discounts) was used. Should have been GL 2395 (Deferred Promotions). Confirm remaining amortizable balances as of 5/31.
Derek (Billing): Exported schedule shows HelioTech remaining = 29,000 (11/12), CrestAI = 13,250, OrbitWorks = 5,067. Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/onboard-grants-export (view).
Omar (Controller): Materiality: HelioTech >25k so VP Finance sign-off required. Also decide prior period correction designation.
Claire (RevRec): Proposed reclassification entries (per customer) to move remaining balances to deferred liability and reverse immediate recognition. Example JE for HelioTech:
```
Date: 2026-06-03
DR 4300 Sales Discounts 29,000
CR 2395 Deferred Revenue - Promotions 29,000
Memo: Reclass ONBOARD-GRANT remaining balance for INV-14021; attach amort schedule and invoice.
```
Hannah (Accounting): For CrestAI DR 4300 13,250 / CR 2395 13,250; OrbitWorks DR 4300 5,067 / CR 2395 5,067. Net aggregate reclass = 47,317.
tax-bot: Flag: reclassification may shift taxable revenue timing. Loop in Tax Ops for review.
Jules (VP Finance): Approved the JE approach. HelioTech treated as prior period correction given amount and timing; include disclosure in the close notes. CrestAI and OrbitWorks treat as normal corrections. Please prepare one-line audit rationale.
Claire (RevRec): Draft audit rationale: "Onboarding grant credits constitute consideration for future access and services over a 12-month period; initial classification as one-time discounts was incorrect per revenue policy and has been reclassified to deferred revenue to recognize ratably."
Omar (Controller): Action items: 1) Hannah post JEs to NetSuite and tag HelioTech JE as PPC; 2) Derek implement billing validation so ONBOARD-GRANT* SKUs route to GL 2395; 3) Claire update revenue rollforward and produce revised close pack; 4) Tax Ops to confirm any tax timing adjustments. Deadline: EOD next business day.
Derek (Billing): Adding validation now. Will open ticket BC-4987 and add unit test that asserts ONBOARD-GRANT SKUs are deferred. PR link: BC-PR-1032.
Hannah (Accounting): Posted NetSuite JEs: NS-JE-588901 (HelioTech - PPC), NS-JE-588902 (CrestAI), NS-JE-588903 (OrbitWorks). Memos include invoice refs and amort schedule link. Circulating updated revenue rollforward.
tax-bot: Task created: TAX-1223 assigned to @Priya (Tax Ops) for review of timing impact.
Claire (RevRec): Closing loop: billing ticket BC-4987 and NetSuite JEs attached to the month-end folder. Will follow up if Tax Ops requests adjustments.
